query: What are NVIDIA's gross margin figures and fiscal Q4 margin outlook?
expected_answer: NVIDIA GAAP gross margin was 74.6% and non-GAAP was 75.1% in Q3. For Q4 FY25, gross margins are expected to be 73.0% GAAP and 73.5% non-GAAP, plus or minus 50 basis points, before rebounding to the mid-70s later in the year.

query: What was Apple's active installed base and shareholder return during Q4 FY24?
expected_answer: Apple's active installed base reached an all-time high across all products and geographic segments. Apple returned over $29 billion to shareholders during the quarter, including $3.8 billion in dividends and $25 billion in share repurchases.

query: How did Microsoft Cloud perform in revenue and gross margin?
expected_answer: Microsoft Cloud revenue was $38.9 billion, up 22% year-over-year. Microsoft Cloud gross margin percentage was 71%, down slightly due to the scaling of AI infrastructure.

query: What details were provided on NVIDIA Networking revenue growth?
expected_answer: Networking revenue was $3.12 billion, up 20% year-over-year, driven by strong demand for InfiniBand and Spectrum-X Ethernet networking platforms.

query: What were Apple's Mac and iPad revenues in Q4 fiscal 2024?
expected_answer: Mac revenue was $7.74 billion, up 2% year-over-year propelled by M3 MacBook Air. iPad revenue was $6.95 billion, up 8% year-over-year driven by the updated iPad Air and iPad Pro.
